items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: Cousin. Cousin is cousin. Cher, cher means dear. And cousin means cousin.

ctx.x: Okay. Tell me what is my dear cousin?

Cousin. Cousin is cousin. Cher, cher means dear. And cousin means cousin. Can you repeat dear again? Cher, cher, cher. And say cousin. Cousin, cousin, cousin. And la main, la main, la main, light. And how do you say kitchen? Cousine, cuisine, cuisine. That's a French word too. He's in it. Cousine, that's right.
And what's next? I like your kitchen and what else do you?
